messages.subject: Negative WAIC
parts:
Hi nimble user,

When I run the model I got a negative value for WAIC
Also I got the warning massage:

 [Warning] There are individual pWAIC values that are greater than 0.4. This may indicate that the WAIC estimate is unstable (Vehtari et al., 2017), at least in cases without grouping of data nodes or multivariate data nodes.


is that means that the WAIC estimate is unstable, or the model is overfitting the data so I need to  consider trying a different model , or using a different model evaluation?

Can you please advice in this regard?

Kind regards,
Wala

messages.author: d78486bfff620d81
messages.subject: Re: Negative WAIC
parts:
Hi Wala,

As far as negative WAIC, there is nothing that guarantees it will be positive. It is the sum of a log predictive density term that could be negative or positive and a variance (pWAIC) term that will be positive. So it could be positive or negative.

As far as the 0.4 values, we don't have much guidance to give except what is stated in the Vehtari et al. reference. However, I think it's possible that this could occur if the MCMC chain is too short, so you might try running the chain for longer if you don't already have a long chain with sufficient mixing/ESS.

-chris
